description: This file defines functions related to managing and deriving labels for chat sessions, including creating human-friendly session names and resolving session choices based on recency and other criteria.

methods.name: friendlySessionName
methods.description: Generates a human-friendly label from a raw session key by stripping prefixes, cleaning, and formatting words.

methods.name: resolveSessionChoices
methods.description: Resolves a list of chat session entries based on current context, recency, and predefined main session, returning an ordered list of sessions for display or selection.
